meta.exam_title: Class test no. 5 – The city and its surroundings (Unit 4)

criteria.short: 5 unhöfliche Sätze höflich umformuliert.
criteria.intro: Erwartete Umformulierungen mit Excuse me / can, could you (please)…?, z. B.:
bullets: 1 Excuse me, can/could you tell me where the Meridian line is, please?
2 Excuse me, could you give me a city map, please?
3 Excuse me, I don't want to go to the Royal Observatory, if that's okay.
4 Excuse me, could I use your phone to google the price for Mudchute Farm, please?
5 Excuse me, I'm afraid I haven't got time to go to Greenwich Pier.
schema: Je Satz 1 P: höfliche Einleitung (**Excuse me**, **Could/Can you…?**, **please**) + inhaltlich passende Umformulierung

criteria.short: Lösung: 1 true, 2 true, 3 false, 4 true, 5 false, 6 false.
Lösung: special, about, city, museum, costs, leisure, fine.
Do you live in the city?
bullets: Do you live in the city?

criteria.short: No, I don't.
Do you and your family like animals?
bullets: Do you and your family like animals?

criteria.short: Yes, we do.
Do your dogs help you with your work?
bullets: Do your dogs help you with your work?

criteria.short: Yes, they do!
Do they live in the barn?
bullets: Do they live in the barn?

criteria.short: No, they don't.
Does your father feed the animals every morning?
bullets: Does your father feed the animals every morning?

criteria.short: Yes, he does. And every evening, too!
bullets: Yes, he does. And every evening, too!
schema: Korrekte Kurzantwort mit **does**, vollständig inkl. Zusatz

criteria.short: Conny doesn't live in the city. She lives on a farm.
bullets: Conny doesn't live in the city. She lives on a farm.
schema: 1,5 P korrekte Verneinung mit **doesn't**, 1 P inhaltlich passender Zusatzsatz

sections.titel: 6 Writing a dialogue: A day at Mudchute farm? Soccer is better!

criteria.short: Ausdrucksvermögen/Wortschatz passend zum Thema.
schema: Passender, abwechslungsreicher Wortschatz zu Freizeit/Stadt (z. B. **exciting**, **boring**, **cost money**, **water slides**)

criteria.short: Grammatik: Pflichtelemente korrekt (1 Verneinung, 1 do/does-Frage).
Sprachrichtigkeit: Rechtschreibung, Zeichensetzung, Satzbau.
Dialog erfüllt die Aufgabe vollständig (6 Sätze, beide Pflichtelemente, Auseinandersetzung Mudchute Farm vs. Arches Leisure Centre).
schema: Enthält 1 Verneinung mit don't/doesn't und 1 Frage mit Do/Does
Inhaltlich stimmige Auseinandersetzung mit den beiden Freizeitangeboten
